banks.name: Symphony orchestra
banks.description: Woodwinds, brass, timpani, harp, strings and a choir, plus two synths. Built in.

banks.name: Jazz combo
banks.description: Piano, vibes, tenor, alto and bass sax, jazz guitar, upright bass and a drum kit; plus the orchestral trumpets and trombones.

banks.name: Folk group
banks.description: Fiddle, banjo, folk harp, Irish flute, recorder, harmonica, washboard, frame drum and hand percussion; plus flute, clarinet, cellos and basses.

banks.name: Electronica
banks.description: FM piano and clavisynth from a TX81Z, a synthesized drum machine, and lead, pad and pluck synth patches; plus the synth bass and arp.
